subject: Mutual action plan & exit gates — ClearHealth evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.z@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan & exit gates — ClearHealth evaluation timeline

Emily — great to meet on Friday. As promised, attached is an initial mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation milestones, clear exit gates, and the acceptance tests we suggest for the pilot. High-level ask from your side: confirm which of the listed KPIs are deal-breakers for your compliance team and any hard dates for go/no-go so we can prioritize resources.

Key proposed timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (Dec 6): Kickoff and environment setup (VPC peering, test dataset ingest)
- Week 1 (Dec 13): Baseline runs — latency/throughput profile with sample queries
- Week 2 (Dec 20): Acceptance tests (accuracy/regression checks, privacy audit)
- Week 3 (Dec 27): Final stress tests + decision sync

Exit gates (examples):
- Security: SOC2 evidence and network config validated by your security owner
- Performance: 95th pct latency <= 380 ms on 1k qps synthetic workload OR agreed alternate profile
- Quality: F1 on our labeled eval set >= 0.78 OR no regressions vs baseline on key prompts
- Cost/ops: steady-state cost estimate within 15% of forecast when using suggested batching/quantization

Acceptance tests are in the attached markdown (clearhealth-eval-test-suite.md). I attached an editable MAP spreadsheet so we can iterate.

Next steps: if you confirm the set of KPIs and the Week 0 kickoff date (Dec 6), we’ll lock resources and send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Priyom
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-ClearHealth-v1.xlsx (xlsx), clearhealth-eval-test-suite.md (text)
From: Emily Zhang <emily.z@clearhealth.com>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.p@clearhealth.com>, ClearHealth Legal <legal@clearhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & exit gates — ClearHealth evaluation timeline

Thanks Priyom — this is helpful and very structured. Quick notes from our side:
- Security: our security lead needs a short bulleted SOC2 evidence list (logs, retention window, encryption at rest/in transit). Can Marissa please add the checklist?
- Performance: we can agree to the latency gate but the target should be 95th <= 420 ms on our production-ish sample. We’ll provide the sample trace by end of day Thu.
- Quality: we prefer a precision-focused metric for our classification flows — can you add precision@k alongside F1?
- Dates: Dec 6 kickoff is fine for a high-level technical kickoff. Legal wants to see a short SLA addendum before Week 3 ramp.

Also attaching our internal decision owner list (will send separately) — Raj is primary for procurement.

Emily
Director of ML Platforms
ClearHealth Analytics

Emily / team — I took a pass at the acceptance test definitions in the attached markdown (clearhealth-eval-test-suite.md). Highlights and clarifications: 
- Security checklist: included specific artifact names (audit logs with 90-day retention, KMS key policy export, network peering diagram).
- Performance tests: two profiles included — "interactive" (low latency, smaller batch) and "bulk" (throughput-focused). We recommend running both; exit gate requires the interactive profile to meet agreed latency OR bulk profile to meet your throughput with <1.2x cost overhead.
- Quality tests: we added precision@5 and regression delta rules. For tie-breaking, product and your ML lead will jointly review a 200-example random sample.
- Test harness: we’ll provide a small pytest-based harness that runs the evals and produces a pass/fail report you can upload to HubSpot as evidence.

I also included remediation steps for common failures (e.g., quantization accuracy drop, KV cache warm-up).

Attaching: clearhealth-eval-test-suite.md, redwood-sla-proposal.pdf

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
